name: SoLID
notes: Meets the inclusion bar through published design documents naming JLab Hall A (arXiv:1409.7741 white paper; arXiv:2209.13357 overview and apparatus paper), not through approval: the project is proposed, not approved or under construction.
Approved physics proposals (PAC): five (PVDIS E12-10-007, SIDIS E12-10-006, E12-11-007, E12-11-108, J/psi E12-12-006) plus BNSSA PR12-22-004, per the SoLID experiments page.
INSPIRE experiment id not looked up: inspirehep.net is off-limits to coverage streams (STREAM_RULES); external.inspire_experiment left null for the integrator.

physics_goals.quote: A series of experiments will probe the confined motions (3-D imaging) of partons inside protons and neutrons
physics_goals.value: Probe the 3D (transverse-momentum) structure of the nucleon with SIDIS, search for new interactions with parity-violating DIS, and study near-threshold J/psi production

summary.plain: SoLID is a planned large detector for Jefferson Lab's Hall A that combines a big solenoid magnet with very high beam intensity. It is designed to image how quarks move inside protons and neutrons, to test the Standard Model with parity-violating scattering, and to study J/psi production near threshold.
summary.technical: Solenoidal Large Intensity Device: large-acceptance, high-luminosity (10^37-10^39 /cm^2/s) forward spectrometer with full azimuthal coverage for SIDIS (TMDs, transversity, tensor charges on polarised 3He and NH3), parity-violating DIS and near-threshold J/psi electroproduction at the 12 GeV CEBAF; five proposals approved by the JLab PAC, DOE Science Review March 2021, project awaiting DOE CD-0 as of February 2026.
